description: This Java source file defines the DispatcherServlet class for the OpenMRS web application. It extends Spring's DispatcherServlet and manages initialization, reinitialization, and shutdown procedures for the application's web framework, including handling module updates and database initialization checks.

classes.name: DispatcherServlet
classes.description: A custom Servlet class extending Spring's DispatcherServlet, responsible for initializing, reinitializing, and shutting down the web application's dispatcher context in OpenMRS.

methods.name: initFrameworkServlet
methods.description: Overrides the initialization method to set the application context class loader and perform additional setup for module configuration.

methods.name: reInitFrameworkServlet
methods.description: Reinitializes the framework servlet, refreshing module advice and application context after modules are added or updated.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, performing startup checks and logging information related to database updates and initialization requirements.

methods.name: stopAndCloseApplicationContext
methods.description: Stops and closes the servlet's application context, handling exceptions during shutdown.
